title: The Standard Model
description: Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

puzzle.goal: The Higgs doublet carries weak isospin and hypercharge, so its derivative must be made gauge-covariant. Write the covariant derivative D_μ: the ordinary derivative plus couplings to the three weak gauge fields W^a (through the isospin generators τ^a/2, strength g) and to the hypercharge field B (strength g_Y, generator Y/2).
puzzle.name: Electroweak covariant derivative (W and Z masses from symmetry breaking)
puzzle.form: ∂ _ μ - i * g / 2 * τ ^ a * W _ μ ^ a - i * gY / 2 * Y * B _ μ
puzzle.ask: Putting the Higgs vacuum value v into |D_μΦ|² gives m_W = g v/2 and m_Z = √(g² + g_Y²)·v/2. Find the Z boson mass.
puzzle.method: Demand that the Lagrangian stay unchanged under local SU(2)×U(1) rotations of the doublet; each generator needs its own gauge field, and the 1/2 comes from the isospin generators being τ/2.
